summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a binding LOI to acquire 100% of Skycore Digital LLC. Consideration is up to $22M in Series B Convertible Preferred with $1,000 stated value, 8% cash or 10% PIK dividend, and a conversion price at 110% of VWAP. The board has not yet formally recommended; the LOI is subject to a working capital adjustment and definitive agreement. A Certificate of Designation will be filed at closing. Watch for definitive purchase agreement terms and regulatory clearance; risk-arb focuses on conversion mechanics and power-capacity milestone for additional shares.
